notes.title: 2024 February Next Fest - Livestream
notes.content:
[h3]WILL YOU ENJOY ARCSINE?
WHAT TO KNOW BEFORE YOU BUY:[/h3]
[list]
[*][u][b]ArcSine is a physically active standing experience - No smooth/snap turning[/b][/u]
[*][u][b]Get ready for a significant challenge[/b][/u] - This game will push you hard
[*][u][b]Watch the trailer![/b][/u]
[*]Fast-paced, first-person, VR, single-player, linear, storyless, precision puzzle platforming
[*]340+ stages with a huge variety of environment/movement mechanics
[*]A sweeping & intricate electronic soundtrack
[*]Motion-smoothed wide angle streaming mode
[*]Instant respawns and stage loading
[*]Leaderboards and real-time speedrunning stats
[/list]

[h3]ArcSine[/h3]
A first-person VR puzzle platformer that will push your dexterity to its limits. Learn numerous mechanics that help or hinder you as you navigate more than 340 dynamic environments to their end. An epic journey of mental and physical perseverance.
